name: NA60+ MWPC 2100 V K2A fast cathode response: sealed-set acceptance criteria
status: FROZEN before any sealed event was opened; changing anything below requires a new version, and a version created after the sealed set has been opened makes that set no longer independent

sealed_set.definition: the 10 phi + 10 omega events of sealed_validation20.csv in the audited frozen selection (phase_space_2100_signal40_v1); role sealed_validation in the preflight slots.csv
sealed_set.exclusions: none: every sealed event appears in the result table

comparison.test: K2A (compiled absolute-strip adapter K2AStripEvaluator, frozen kernel, per-primary recentering) vs S0 (frozen ion-only replay p3_replay_full_spectral_muon.py on the frozen RKF export, local per-group S0 summed on absolute strips exactly as in E2b, plus the approximate prompt electron term t_prompt_electron_term.py)
comparison.inputs: both sides from the SAME frozen K256 archive of each sealed event (same birth sample); no new avalanche is generated for the validation. The full-birth (in-memory) moment path is validated separately on development events (T1); the K256-vs-full sampling difference is a separate diagnostic (T2), not part of this test
comparison.signal: ion term + electron step (the signed sum used downstream); ion-only is reported as a diagnostic
unchanged: cathode geometry, strip pitch 1.7 mm, stereo tan 0.1

electronics_provisional.shaper: unit-peak CR-RC^n stand-in, n = 3, tau = Tp / n (NOT the VMM3a transfer function)
electronics_provisional.thresholds: absolute, fixed per plane from the S0 lead-strip peak and applied unchanged to K2A
electronics_provisional.centroid: default peak-weighted centroid over strips above the lowest threshold ('thr'); w = P (c_U + c_V) / 2, u = P (c_V - c_U) / (2 A)

criteria._scope: each criterion must hold for EVERY in-domain sealed event, in BOTH planes (U, V) where per plane, and at BOTH Tp (100, 200 ns); K2A minus S0

lead_strip.exemption: AMBIGUOUS if the two largest S0 strip peaks of that plane differ by <= 1 % of the S0 lead peak: listed, not a failure

hit_flips.exemption: MARGINAL if every flipping strip has its S0 peak within +-2 % of that threshold: listed, not a failure

rationale.lead_strip: a lead change moves the cluster by a strip
rationale.hit_flips: discrete readout: K2A must not create or remove hits away from threshold
rationale.threshold_time_f0.1: << 10 ns bins and the shaper rise
rationale.second_over_lead: charge-sharing lever arm of the centroid
rationale.w_centroid: <= 10 % of an expected ~100 um strip-centroid resolution
rationale.u_centroid: u lever arm 1/(2A) = 5; <= 10 % of an expected ~0.5 mm stereo resolution
rationale.shaped_L2_ceiling: waveform-level sanity ceiling; development shaped L2 0.11-0.30 %

domain.in_domain: every cloud of the event evaluated by K2AStripEvaluator with no blocking status (after per-primary recentering, frozen kernel, no table enlargement, no clamping)
domain.out_of_domain: OUT_OF_DOMAIN with the per-cloud cause; listed with its charge; not evaluated against the criteria

coverage_requirement.basis: development coverage after recentering 929/977 = 95.1 %; P(X <= 16 | n = 20, p = 0.951) = 1.5 %

integrity._meaning: not model criteria; a failure makes the run INVALID (no model verdict) and is repaired on non-sealed data only, without touching criteria, model, kernel or thresholds; every attempt and its outputs are kept
checks: census exact: collected S0 ion charge = exact ions x e (rel <= 1e-9), group census integer
frozen replay time-compression pilot passes for every group (late-step ladder 100 -> 50 -> 20 -> 10 ns of the frozen interface allowed)
kernel_id, transport_id, weighting_id equal to the run-configuration freeze record
identical absolute strip label sets and output clock for K2A and S0 before comparison
no output written inside any frozen reference tree; frozen inputs unchanged before / after

outcome_per_event: PASS (all criteria, both planes, both Tp; exemptions listed)
FAIL (any criterion miss, listed with its value)

verdict.ACCEPTED: no INVALID event, >= 17 of 20 events in domain, and every in-domain event PASS
verdict.NOT_ACCEPTED: any in-domain event FAIL, or fewer than 17 of 20 in domain
verdict.INVALID_RUN: any INVALID event: repair infrastructure on non-sealed data and rerun the whole set; the earlier attempt is kept and reported
verdict.reporting: per channel (phi, omega) and all 20; every event in the table with all metric values, exemptions and causes; diagnostics (ion-only, unshaped L2, multiplicity, all threshold fractions, alternative centroids) reported, never decisive

procedure: Before opening: write the run-configuration freeze record (this file's sha256, kernel_id, transport_id, weighting_id, adapter/engine config model K2A, half strips 5, window 7000 ns, dt 10 ns, electronics above, git commit and sha256 of every tool used, sealed_validation20.csv sha256). It must reference this criteria file unchanged.
The evaluator of these criteria is validated on development (non-sealed) events before the freeze record is written.
The sealed runner refuses to start without a freeze record whose criteria sha256 matches this file and whose tool hashes match the checked-out code.
All 20 events are run; nothing is excluded, re-selected or re-run selectively.
No retuning after opening. If the model, kernel, recentering or electronics are changed afterwards, the sealed set is spent: reported as such and no longer called an independent validation.
